name: browser-monkey
description: Two-phase browser API acceleration for no-API sources. The Sniffer discovers what APIs a site actually calls; Monkey replays them at fetch() speed with your own logged-in session — no Playwright UI, no API keys. Pull analytics from dashboards that have no public API (Substack and friends) into Supabase, then save the proven workflow as a reusable slash command. NOT for anti-bot platforms like LinkedIn.
